summary: Keep peer failure telemetry intact on advanced retry admission refusal

replay.detail: Envelope receipt, duplicate handling, projection and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No durable table, index or data-format changes; retry credit is private task-local state.

rules.detail: No claim or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Typed local advanced-admission refusal bypasses the generic peer-failure record and HTTP client reset. Original transport, authentication and signed-overload failures retain their existing effects. Ordinary exchange APIs are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional service interruption beyond a normal binary swap.

manual.detail: No new configuration or manual action.

recovery.detail: No peer-down report or client reset is generated solely because a completed advanced exchange lost its permission before returning success. Credit remains spent and retained deadline/backoff behavior is unchanged; committed effects remain committed. The rate-policy disclosure now distinguishes nominal 3s probing from the 30s cap, credit lifetime from aggregate rate, and a full multi-POST exchange from a single request. Source-only; original recovery/performance and quarantine gates remain open.
